notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
Changes
Reduced the chance of crashing after a hard landing.

The more parallel the vehicle is to the landing surface, the less damage it takes.

Fixed parts of the "Cape" course.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Changes
Made adjustments to parts of the "Cape" course.

Added a new branch at the harbor.

Added a signboard at the final curve.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 "Cape"
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170957/ec61cf5e8770af58cc90d565a4eb71e9c7225f57.png"]



A new race will be held at the cape of a certain island! After passing a lighthouse on a cliff, you can enjoy a thrilling drive as you dive down toward a small harbor.
Additionally, we've improved camera rotation when driving on rough terrain or steep slopes.


Changes
Added a new stage, "Cape."

Restricted vertical camera rotation while driving on uneven roads. 

Adjusted the camera angle to align with slopes when driving uphill or downhill.

Made the camera angle change more quickly upon hard landings.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 "Deep Forest"
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170957/fe1f7a24a95de05bafaf32effe5b1b999c06c718.png

A new racetrack has been built in the forest! ...Wait, there’s still a tree in the middle of the road? Oh well, veteran drivers should have no trouble racing through it!

Trailer
[previewyoutube=5wSsHij0N44;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes

Added a new stage: "Deep Forest".
Adjusted the bottom hitbox of Buggy, Sedan, and ATV to reduce unintended collisions with the ground.
Increased the size of ground effects while driving straight and drifting.

notes.title: v1.0.0 Released!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170957/0ae17eb5be73106ec5834cbcb4d1fe9bd6382ef9.png

Grind Rush has exited early access and is now officially released as v1.0.0!  

In v1.0.0, six courses and four types of vehicles are available. The visuals have also been enhanced, including the addition of outlines to objects, improving not only the appearance but also making obstacles easier to recognize.  

Thanks to all the players and those who provided valuable feedback, the game has become more refined. We truly appreciate your support!  

We will continue to update the game beyond v1.0.0, so please stay tuned and keep supporting us.  

[previewyoutube=ajiCptlK3FE;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes  
  
 The previously in-development "Construction" track has been completed.  
 The previously in-development "Canyon" track has been completed.  
 Increased downforce while airborne from 0% to 50%, making it easier to drive on rough terrain.  
 Debris from destroyed objects now bounces more realistically.  
 Reduced the load of destructible objects.  
 Added sound effects for drifting.  
 Increased braking power.  
 Fixed a bug where damage from below was not properly reduced.  
 Increased damage taken from above.  
 Significantly reduced the durability of the ATV. Players must avoid rival vehicles when driving it.  
 Drivers are now ejected when the ATV crashes.  
 AI at all difficulty levels now actively use boosts.  
 Rookie and Veteran AI may occasionally fail their boost and explode.  
 Made the post-finish camera movements more cinematic.  
 Adjusted overall visuals.  
  
 Added outlines to objects.  
 Lightened the colors of distant objects.  
 Tweaked some effects.  
 Fixed unnaturally glowing jungle trees.  
  
 Added two new music tracks.  
 Music now plays randomly in tracks other than the tutorial.  
 Fixed an issue where the second AI in the tutorial could not start.  
 Fixed an issue where engine sounds continued playing when the race was paused.  
 Fixed the rendering order of effects when switching scenes.  
 Added track thumbnail images to the race selection screen.  
 When playing with a controller, pressing the confirm button on the race selection and vehicle selection screens now proceeds to the next screen.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170957/633d4bb55599ac06814f4fef3ab2ba9e8004b623.png

The new track "Jungle Ruins" is now fully playable!
Additionally, you can choose the strength of AI, and the UI has been updated.

[previewyoutube=8BJ6N_aN3fY;full][/previewyoutube]


 The previously in-development "Jungle Ruins" track is now complete.
 You can now select AI strength from three levels.
 Redesigned the UI.
 Added no-entry death zones to some tracks.
 Fixed an issue where cars would fly excessively upon crashing.
 Added a sound at the start of the race.
 Added a sound for when the boost overheats.
 Modified some sounds, such as for the boost.
 Adjusted some effects, such as explosions.
 Reduced the impact when colliding with some destructible objects.
 Reduced damage taken upon landing.

notes.title: Version 0.1.4 Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170957/ffcbe1148d1171a4c080b32759c57f11dd175ea5.png

The new track "Canyon," currently in development, is now playable!  
The canyon features wide roads with elevation changes, and you'll even have opportunities to jump over gaps. Be careful not to fall into the valley!  

- Added the new development track "Canyon."  
- Updated the game engine to Unity 6.

notes.title: Version 0.1.3 Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170957/7ec7da4a1c50ab73442eff9603be7781a9c40d22.png  

The new track under development is now playable!  
The construction site is scattered with unfinished buildings and equipment—navigate skillfully to aim for the top! If you're driving a monster truck, crashing into obstacles might even be a good strategy.  

- Added the new track in development, "Construction Site."  
- Increased the paths accessible to enemy AI.  
- Fixed enemy AI to reduce the likelihood of collisions at the start of a race.  
- Slightly widened the starting area path in "Junker Forest."
